business: ILLUSTRUS v4 — integrări și pagini pentru clienții finanțați ai agențiilor (sursa A)
target: the owner or project lead of a small web/digital agency in Oradea or Bucharest, Romania (2-12 people), that builds WordPress sites and does SEO/social for SMEs, some of whom have grant-funded projects; the income figure above is your AGENCY's annual revenue in EUR

segments.name: Micro agency, 2-4 people, sites at 400-1,000 EUR, 20-40 projects a year
Small agency, 5-12 people, sites at 1,000-3,000 EUR, retainers, some custom work
Agency with a dev team, 12+ people, builds its own integrations

behaviours.name: Has in-house WordPress devs, no automation
behaviours.how: Turns down or hand-waves requests for integrations; has never sold an automation.

behaviours.name: Already uses freelancers
behaviours.how: Has 2-3 freelancers on Upwork or locally; has been let down by one before a deadline.

behaviours.name: Margin-driven owner
behaviours.how: Asks 'what do I bill the client and what do you cost me' before anything else.

behaviours.name: Burned by subcontractors
behaviours.how: A subcontractor once went silent mid-project; now insists on seeing work before paying.

behaviours.name: Curious about AI/automation offers
behaviours.how: Wants to add 'automation' to the service list but has no one to deliver it.
